title: BitVLA: 1-bit Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotics Manipulation
reported_metric: 11.0x lower memory, 4.4x lower end-to-end latency vs OpenVLA-OFT
tldr: Builds a VLA natively on a ternary (1.58-bit) LLM and compresses the vision encoder to 1.58 bits via a quantize-then-distill QAT stage with a full-precision teacher; matches OpenVLA-OFT while shrinking memory ~11x.
relevance_reason: Seed work; first fully native 1-bit VLA.

title: Quantization-Aware Imitation-Learning for Resource-Efficient Robotic Control
hardware: edge GPU (Jetson-class); low-end GPU for driving
reported_metric: up to 2.5x speedup, 2.5x energy saving (W4 manipulation); 3.7x speedup, 3.1x energy (W4A4 driving)
tldr: QAIL fine-tunes imitation-learning policies (incl. OpenVLA) with a quantization-robust objective so 4-bit weight/activation models keep accuracy; measured speed and energy savings on edge GPUs.
relevance_reason: Seed work; first QAT framework for IL/VLA policies.

title: Saliency-Aware Quantized Imitation Learning for Efficient Robotic Control
reported_metric: up to 2.5x speedup and 2.5x energy savings (4-bit weights)
tldr: SQIL extends QAIL by up-weighting salient, mission-critical states in the QAT loss so low-bit policies keep decision fidelity where it matters.
relevance_reason: Direct follow-up of QAIL for quantized VLAs.

title: SQAP-VLA: A Synergistic Quantization-Aware Pruning Framework for High-Performance Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: 1.93x speedup
tldr: Co-designs quantization with token pruning, introducing quantization-aware pruning criteria so both can be applied together without the incompatibility seen when stacking them naively.
relevance_reason: Joint quantization+pruning for VLAs.

title: RLRC: Reinforcement Learning-based Recovery for Compressed Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: up to 8x memory reduction, 2.3x inference speedup
tldr: Systematically studies VLA compression and proposes prune -> SFT+RL recovery -> quantize, using RL with critic warm-up and BC regularization to regain success rate lost to pruning.
relevance_reason: Full compression pipeline for VLAs with RL-based recovery.

title: EaqVLA: Encoding-aligned Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Identifies token/encoding misalignment in VLAs as a barrier for off-the-shelf quantizers and proposes an alignment-aware mixed-precision scheme.
relevance_reason: VLA-specific PTQ; abstract lacks concrete speed numbers.

title: QVLA: Not All Channels Are Equal in Vision-Language-Action Model's Quantization
reported_metric: 29.2% of original VRAM, 98.9% of performance, 1.49x speedup
tldr: Allocates per-channel bit-widths (including 0-bit, i.e. pruning) by measuring action-space sensitivity, outperforming LLM-style uniform quantizers like SmoothQuant on VLAs.
relevance_reason: Action-centric quantization framework unifying pruning and quantization.

title: QuantVLA: Scale-Calibrated Post-Training Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
base_model: pi0 / GR00T-style VLAs with DiT heads
reported_metric: ~70% relative memory savings on quantized components
tldr: Training-free PTQ that also integerizes the diffusion-transformer action head, using attention temperature matching and output-head balancing to prevent calibration drift.
relevance_reason: First PTQ covering DiT action heads.

title: DyQ-VLA: Temporal-Dynamic-Aware Quantization for Embodied Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: 30.9% memory, 99.5% performance, 1.49x sim / up to 1.43x real-world speedup
tldr: Switches bit-widths at runtime based on kinematic proxies of how error-sensitive the current motion phase is, instead of a fixed precision.
relevance_reason: Temporal-adaptive quantization for VLAs.

title: ActQuant: Sub-4-bit Action-Guided Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: 95.0% retained at <=3 bpw (OpenVLA-OFT); backbone 14.3 GB -> 2.7 GB at 2.5 bpw
tldr: Action-guided PTQ that assigns per-tensor bit-widths by action contribution and tunes block scales with action-aware curvature, plus a C/C++ runtime for low-bit kernels.
relevance_reason: Sub-4-bit PTQ with real-robot validation.

title: HBVLA: Pushing 1-Bit Post-Training Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: 92.2% of FP performance (OpenVLA-OFT, LIBERO); 93.6% (CogACT, SimplerEnv)
tldr: VLA-specific binarization: policy-aware Hessian picks salient weights, sparse orthogonal transform eases the rest, then group-wise 1-bit quantization in the Haar domain.
relevance_reason: Pushes PTQ of VLAs to 1 bit.

title: HoloQ-VLA: Uniform W4A4 Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: 74.2% static memory reduction at W4A4
tldr: Uniform W4A4 PTQ of both backbone and diffusion head via weight-adapted rotation plus Hadamard transform and per-denoising-step scaling.
relevance_reason: First uniform W4A4 of full VLA including action head.

title: DA-PTQ: Drift-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Frames PTQ as minimizing trajectory drift over sequential control, compensating VL-to-action representation distortion and allocating bits by motion error.
relevance_reason: Addresses closed-loop error accumulation from quantization.

title: FoldQuantVLA: Native Low-Bit Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models via Consistent Folding
reported_metric: 1.20-1.33x speedup over FP TensorRT on Orin; 1.25-1.52x on desktop
tldr: PTQ with channel scaling, block Hadamard and dynamic per-token quantization executed natively as W4A4 TensorRT plugins on Orin; mixed W8A8 for sensitive projections boosts real-robot success.
relevance_reason: Native low-bit execution on robot-grade hardware with real-robot trials.

title: VLAQuantBench: Closed-Loop Evaluation of Post-Training Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: 409 runs / 94,574 simulated episodes
tldr: Large controlled closed-loop study of VLA PTQ showing that success depends on recipe-specific interactions of layer scope, format and calibration, e.g. protecting a single tiny output projection rescues OpenVLA-OFT.
relevance_reason: Benchmark directly probing whether/when quantization breaks closed-loop VLA behavior.

title: Mix-QVLA: Task-Evidence-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: 15.4 GB -> 4.1 GB memory, 96.3 vs 97.1 success, 1.52x speedup
tldr: Scores layer sensitivity by how quantization distorts gradient-weighted task-evidence maps over the episode and allocates bits under size/BitOps budgets.
relevance_reason: Phase-aware mixed-precision PTQ for VLAs.

title: LiteVLA-Edge: Quantized On-Device Multimodal Control for Embedded Robotics
reported_metric: 150.5 ms mean end-to-end latency (~6.6 Hz)
tldr: Systems recipe: fine-tune a compact VLA, quantize to 4-bit GGUF and run it through llama.cpp on a Jetson inside a ROS 2 loop, establishing timing feasibility rather than task success.
relevance_reason: Onboard quantized VLA deployment baseline; no task-level eval.

title: Predict Before You Deploy: Offline Prediction of Quantization-Induced Task Degradation for World Action Models
reported_metric: 21/28 held-out configs decided offline, all correct
tldr: PreDE predicts which quantization configs of world-action models will degrade closed-loop success from offline action deviations, cutting costly rollout sweeps; validated with 450 Franka trials.
relevance_reason: Addresses predicting quantization harm before deployment.

title: Q-WAM: 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models with Action-Subspace Protection
reported_metric: 89.6-93.0% avg success on RoboTwin 2.0, within 1.1 pp of 16-bit
tldr: 4-bit weight-activation PTQ for world-action models that keeps the most action-sensitive channel subspace in a tiny 16-bit low-rank branch, applied only to action-critical experts.
relevance_reason: Quantization tailored to world-action models.

title: QuantWAMs: Calibrating at the Right Granularity for World Action Models
reported_metric: ~29% of FP16 peak weight+activation memory for targeted blocks; sim success within 0.2-0.7 pp
tldr: PTQ for WAMs that calibrates outliers only across compatible modules, allocates precision via joint video-action Fisher scores, and audits denoising-step protection using closed-loop states.
relevance_reason: W4A4-dominant WAM quantization with real-robot tests.

title: Bit-Flip Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models: Action-Decoding Architecture Shapes the Vulnerability
tldr: Shows a handful of gradient-chosen bit flips in INT8 VLA weights can zero closed-loop success, with flow-matching heads needing far more flips than regression/token heads; protecting a few percent of weights helps.
relevance_reason: Safety/security of quantized deployed VLAs.

title: Bimanual Manipulation Within an 8 GB Budget: Zero-Copy Sensing and Quantized ACT on an Entry-Level Jetson
reported_metric: ACT latency 114.02 ms -> 12.65 ms with INT8 (9.0x), success 19/20
tldr: Runs a bimanual ACT policy entirely on an entry-level Jetson; TensorRT FP16/INT8 cut per-inference latency up to 9x without losing task success.
relevance_reason: Concrete INT8 onboard deployment evidence for IL policy.

title: Anatomy of a Closed-Loop Collapse: A Causal Case Study of a Compressed VLA Policy
reported_metric: student 0/72 vs teacher 40/72 despite passing offline checks
tldr: Causal case study of an 8-layer Octo distillation that passes offline metrics but fails closed-loop; only training on deployment-distribution teacher rollouts repairs it.
relevance_reason: Direct evidence that compressed policies can silently break closed-loop.

title: When Faster VLA Deployment Changes Closed-Loop Behavior: Task Success-Latency Analysis of SmolVLA Across PyTorch and ONNX Variants
reported_metric: p99 latency 1181 ms -> 532-601 ms
tldr: Finds that 'faster' ONNX exports of SmolVLA change closed-loop success, and that a claimed INT8 export was actually an FP32 graph; urges auditing artifacts alongside latency and success.
relevance_reason: Cautionary deployment study on compression/export claims.

title: Recti-Q: Feature-Space Rectification for Out-of-Distribution-Robust Quantized Perception in Edge Robotics
tldr: Shows 4-bit PTQ vision backbones lose OOD robustness despite clean accuracy and recovers it with a tiny LoRA head adapter.
relevance_reason: Evidence that quantization harms generalization under shift for robot perception.

title: EdgeVLN: Runtime-Aware Deployment Ready Quantized Vision Language Navigation Model
reported_metric: 58.02% SR at 4-bit, +0.013 s per step
tldr: Sweeps StreamVLN weight precision 8->2 bits on Jetson and adds a lightweight stop head reusing backbone states, getting a 4-bit navigation model that beats BF16 SR.
relevance_reason: Quantized embodied navigation foundation model onboard.

title: QuantWM: Temporally Consistent 2-Bit KV Cache Quantization for Video World Models
tldr: Training-free 2-bit KV-cache quantization for video world models that preserves attention logits/token selection to avoid temporal flicker.
relevance_reason: Compression of world models (not robot-evaluated).

title: A Motion-Aware Vector Quantization Framework with Centroid Reuse for Efficient VLA Inference
reported_metric: 6.5x speedup over A100
tldr: VQVLA co-designs motion-aware vector-quantized weights with a centroid-reuse GEMM accelerator, varying precision with the robot's execution state.
relevance_reason: Weight VQ + accelerator for VLAs.

title: Algorithm-Architecture Co-Design for Efficient VLA Inference via Speculative Inference and Verification
tldr: SpecVLA predicts long action spans in inactive states and verifies in active ones with a small mixed-precision-quantized verifier model on a GPU+custom module.
relevance_reason: Uses quantized small-model construction; primarily a scheduling co-design.

title: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
reported_metric: 1.05-2.70x speedup and 7-77% lower VRAM vs Python baselines
tldr: Portable C++ runtime for VLAs and WAMs; compares quantization configurations across Python and C++ stacks while tracking success rate.
relevance_reason: Deployment runtime that operationalizes quantized embodied models.

title: vla.cpp: A Unified Inference Runtime for Vision-Language-Action Models
hardware: Jetson Orin Nano 8 GB; RTX 3060; AGX Orin
reported_metric: ternary kernel 4.0-4.6x faster than CUDA-core baseline for BitVLA
tldr: Unified C++ VLA runtime; ships a ternary tensor-core kernel that makes BitVLA practical on an 8 GB Jetson and shows numeric precision of position indices affects gripper success.
relevance_reason: Makes 1.58-bit VLAs actually fast on edge hardware.

title: vla.simd: Efficient CPU Inference for Language-Conditioned Manipulation
reported_metric: IMPACT policy 33.5 actions/s fp32, 81.2 actions/s int8 on Raspberry Pi 5
tldr: CPU-only inference engine for language-conditioned policies; int8 more than doubles action supply on a Raspberry Pi 5.
relevance_reason: INT8 CPU deployment of robot policies.

title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
reported_metric: 31.2 ms latency, 0.9 GiB VRAM, 97.6% LIBERO
tldr: Drops the LLM-centric pathway and fuses separately encoded vision and language with a compact decoder, reaching strong LIBERO success at 0.2B params.
relevance_reason: Compact-by-design alternative to compressing large VLAs.

title: Don't Run with Scissors: Pruning Breaks VLA Models but They Can Be Recovered
tldr: Shows LLM-style pruning badly degrades VLAs and raises safety violations; GLUESTICK computes a one-shot dense-pruned weight-space correction applied at inference to recover success.
relevance_reason: Key evidence that pruning hurts VLAs, with training-free fix.

title: Recovering Aggressively Pruned Vision-Language-Action Models with Offline Hidden-State Distillation
reported_metric: 63% backbone reduction recovered to within 3.5 pts of teacher in ~8 GPU-hours
tldr: Recovers heavily width-pruned VLA backbones fully offline by matching cached teacher hidden states, replacing costly SFT+RL recovery.
relevance_reason: Cheap recovery of aggressively pruned VLAs.

title: Revisiting Parameter Redundancy in Vision-Language-Action Models: Insights from VLM-to-VLA Adaptation
reported_metric: 12-30% parameter reduction at ~90% performance without fine-tuning
tldr: Uses how much each module's weights drifted during VLM-to-VLA adaptation to decide what can be pruned, yielding a multi-module pruning scheme needing no recovery training.
relevance_reason: Analysis of where redundancy lives in VLAs.

title: Drop-Then-Recovery: How Redundant Are Vision-Language-Action Models?
tldr: Block-removal study finding LLM backbones in VLAs highly redundant (two blocks can suffice) while vision and action pathways are fragile; proposes a one-shot gate sensitivity metric.
relevance_reason: Central redundancy analysis for VLA compression.

title: Finetuning Vision-Language-Action Models Requires Fewer Layers Than You Think
reported_metric: up to 50% depth removed; up to 30% faster inference
tldr: Finds redundant 'twin' layers in flow-matching VLAs via a single-pass CKA analysis and removes them before fine-tuning, speeding both training and inference.
relevance_reason: Depth pruning of continuous-action VLAs incl. action head.
found_via: web search: VLA pruning layers redundancy

title: MoLe-VLA: Dynamic Layer-skipping Vision Language Action Model via Mixture-of-Layers for Efficient Robot Manipulation
tldr: Treats LLM layers as experts and uses a spatial-temporal router to activate a subset per state, with cognition self-distillation to compensate for skipped layers.
relevance_reason: Canonical layer-skipping VLA.

title: DySL-VLA: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model Inference via Dynamic-Static Layer-Skipping for Robot Manipulation
reported_metric: 3.75x speedup vs RoboFlamingo at iso-accuracy; 85.7x fewer trainable params
tldr: Always runs 'informative' layers and skips 'incremental' ones on less critical actions, trained with a skip-aware two-stage distillation.
relevance_reason: Layer-skipping VLA with distillation.

title: Decoupled Early Exits for Task-Dependent Compute Allocation in Flow-Matching VLAs
tldr: Adds exit transformers in both backbone and action expert, jointly tuning backbone depth, expert depth and denoising steps; optimal budget depends on task.
relevance_reason: Early-exit compression for flow VLAs.

title: DeeAD: Dynamic Early Exit of Vision-Language Action for Efficient Autonomous Driving
reported_metric: up to 28% layer sparsity, 29% latency reduction
tldr: Terminates driving-VLA inference when intermediate trajectories agree with cheap planning priors, skipping redundant layers without retraining.
relevance_reason: Early-exit for driving VLA.

title: EfficientVLA: Training-Free Acceleration and Compression for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Training-free framework combining redundancy-guided LLM layer pruning, task-aware visual token selection and caching of diffusion-head features across denoising steps.
relevance_reason: Widely cited holistic training-free VLA compression.
found_via: web search: VLA pruning layers redundancy

title: DeeR-VLA: Dynamic Inference of Multimodal Large Language Models for Efficient Robot Execution
tldr: Adds multiple exits to a robotic MLLM and learns termination criteria under average/peak compute or memory budgets, activating only as much of the model as each situation needs.
relevance_reason: Foundational dynamic-depth VLA work.
found_via: web search: VLA pruning layers redundancy

title: TinyVLA: Towards Fast, Data-Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Builds compact VLAs from small pretrained multimodal backbones plus a diffusion policy decoder, beating OpenVLA on speed and data efficiency without robot pretraining.
relevance_reason: Canonical compact-VLA baseline used in compression comparisons.

title: SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and Efficient Robotics
tldr: Small VLA that uses only part of a small VLM's layers and few visual tokens, trained on community data and deployable on consumer GPUs/CPUs with asynchronous inference.
relevance_reason: Widely used compact VLA that truncates VLM layers.
found_via: web search: TinyVLA SmolVLA compact VLA

title: NanoVLA: Routing Decoupled Vision-Language Understanding for Nano-sized Generalist Robotic Policies
reported_metric: up to 52x faster inference on edge devices
tldr: Family of nano-sized VLAs that fuse vision and language late (enabling caching) and route between light and heavy backbones by task difficulty.
relevance_reason: Edge-sized VLA design with onboard eval.

title: Shallow-π: Knowledge Distillation for Flow-based VLAs
reported_metric: >2x faster inference, <1% absolute success drop
tldr: Distills a flow-based VLA from 18 to 6 transformer layers in both VLM backbone and action head, validated on Jetson-class robots including humanoids.
relevance_reason: Depth distillation of pi-style VLAs with onboard deployment.

title: VITA-VLA: Efficiently Teaching Vision-Language Models to Act via Action Expert Distillation
tldr: Gives a VLM action ability by aligning its hidden states to a small pretrained action model's action space and reusing that model's decoder, avoiding costly VLA pretraining.
relevance_reason: Distillation for cheap VLA training rather than inference compression.

title: ActDistill: General Action-Guided Self-Derived Distillation for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Derives a lightweight student from a VLA teacher and trains a router to execute only needed layers, supervised by hierarchical action-prediction signals.
relevance_reason: General VLA-to-lightweight distillation framework.

title: Teaching Tiny VLA Models Where to Look and How to Move
tldr: Distills coarse spatial grounding labels from a 4B VLM into a 0.25B VLA and adds latent flow matching, lifting tiny-VLA LIBERO-Long success substantially.
relevance_reason: Teacher-student recipe to recover capability in tiny VLAs.
found_via: web search: distilling VLA into small student

title: Offline Semantic Guidance for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policy Distillation
reported_metric: 12.5 Hz, 3.28x faster than OpenVLA-7B, 44x smaller
tldr: Distills OpenVLA (or pi0.5) into a 158M student using teacher actions plus VLM-generated phase and direction hints used only at training time.
relevance_reason: Large-to-tiny VLA distillation with measured speed.
found_via: web search: distilling VLA into small student

title: Think Like a World Model, Act Like a VLA: Distilling World-Model Representations into Compact Robot Policies
reported_metric: 32 ms, 1.86 GB inference
tldr: Adds a single cosine alignment loss against cached world-model features so a compact VLA inherits physical grounding at zero inference cost.
relevance_reason: Distilling large world model into compact policy.
found_via: web search: distilling VLA into small student

title: CoTinyVLA: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for a Sub-Billion-Parameter Vision-Language-Action Model
tldr: Distills hierarchical plan/think reasoning from a 35B teacher into a 0.9B VLA, beating 7B baselines on perturbation robustness.
relevance_reason: Shows compact distilled VLAs can retain robustness.
found_via: web search: TinyVLA compact VLA distillation

title: Refined Policy Distillation: From VLA Generalists to RL Experts
tldr: Uses VLA actions to guide on-policy RL of a compact student, producing task experts that outperform their VLA teachers.
relevance_reason: VLA-to-compact-policy distillation.
found_via: web search: distilling VLA into small student

title: Distillation for Efficient Multitask Manipulation Policies via Conditional Flow Matching
tldr: Distills several single-task flow-matching experts into one fixed-size multi-task policy by matching their velocity fields.
relevance_reason: Multi-expert consolidation at fixed model size.
found_via: search: knowledge distillation robot manipulation policy

title: CAPEX: Efficiently Distilling Foundation Model Behavior into Deployable Robot Policies through Experience-Adaptive Reasoning
tldr: Uses a multimodal foundation model as an autonomous demonstrator, adaptively reducing its calls, to distill behavior into small deployable policies.
relevance_reason: Distillation via data rather than weights.

title: SymVD: Symmetric Vision Language Action Distillation for Robot Manipulation
tldr: Distills a large VLA teacher into a compact equivariant actor-critic student using symmetry-aware objectives and adaptive RL/distillation weighting.
relevance_reason: Teacher-student VLA compression.

title: MINERVA: How Small Can a Manipulation Policy Be and Still Solve LIBERO?
reported_metric: 95.1% LIBERO with 0.54M params (7,700x fewer than pi0.5)
tldr: A sub-1M-parameter policy nearly matches billion-scale VLAs on LIBERO but collapses under LIBERO-Plus perturbations, showing benchmarks under-measure what compression loses.
relevance_reason: Direct evidence on whether small/compressed models lose generalization.

title: SnapFlow: One-Step Action Generation for Flow-Matching VLAs via Progressive Self-Distillation
tldr: Plug-and-play self-distillation that collapses the ~10-step flow denoising of pi0.5/SmolVLA into one step using two-step shortcut targets.
relevance_reason: Distillation of flow VLAs' sampling.

title: One-Step Flow Policy: Self-Distillation for Fast Visuomotor Policies
reported_metric: >100x faster action generation than 100-step baselines
tldr: Trains single-step flow policies from scratch via self-consistency and self-guided regularization, even improving on 10-step pi0.5.
relevance_reason: Teacher-free step distillation.

title: Consistency Policy: Accelerated Visuomotor Policies via Consistency Distillation
venue: arXiv (RSS 2024 per project page; not re-verified)
reported_metric: order-of-magnitude faster inference than fastest alternative
tldr: Distills a Diffusion Policy teacher into a consistency model that generates action sequences in one or few steps, enabling low-latency control on resource-limited robots.
relevance_reason: Seminal diffusion-policy distillation work.

title: One-Step Diffusion Policy: Fast Visuomotor Policies via Diffusion Distillation
reported_metric: action prediction frequency 1.5 Hz -> 62 Hz
tldr: OneDP distills a pretrained diffusion policy into a single-step generator by minimizing KL along the diffusion chain at a small extra training cost.
relevance_reason: Key one-step policy distillation baseline.

title: Score and Distribution Matching Policy: Advanced Accelerated Visuomotor Policies via Matched Distillation
reported_metric: 6x inference speedup
tldr: Two-stage score- and distribution-matching distillation with frozen and adversarial teachers turns diffusion policies into single-step generators.
relevance_reason: One-step distillation for visuomotor policies.

title: ManiCM: Real-time 3D Diffusion Policy via Consistency Model for Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Consistency-distills a point-cloud 3D diffusion policy for one-step action generation in real time.
relevance_reason: Consistency distillation for 3D policies.

title: Hybrid Consistency Policy: Decoupling Multi-Modal Diversity and Real-Time Efficiency in Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Runs a short stochastic prefix then a one-step consistency jump, distilled with time-varying objectives, preserving multimodality at lower latency.
relevance_reason: Distillation trade-off between modes and speed.

title: Dynamic Neural Koopman Distillation for Real-Time Robot Control Using Diffusion Models
tldr: Distills multi-step diffusion planning into one pass using a factorized dynamic Koopman layer, reaching millisecond latency on hardware.
relevance_reason: One-step distillation for control.

title: High-Fidelity One-Step Generative Visuomotor Policy via Recursive Correction, Frequency Consistency, and Contrastive Flow Matching
tldr: Improves one-step flow policies with recursive correction, spectral consistency across timesteps and contrastive flow matching to avoid mode averaging.
relevance_reason: High-fidelity one-step policy compression.

title: From Flow to One Step: Real-Time Multi-Modal Trajectory Policies via Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation-based Distribution Distillation
tldr: Distills a conditional flow-matching expert into a single-step student with IMLE and a set-level Chamfer loss to preserve modes.
relevance_reason: Teacher-student step compression.

title: Sparse ActionGen: Accelerating Diffusion Policy with Real-time Pruning
tldr: Learns an observation-conditioned pruner that decides which diffusion computations to skip and reuses cached activations, adapting sparsity to the rollout.
relevance_reason: Structured runtime pruning of diffusion policies.

title: Test-time Sparsity for Extreme Fast Action Diffusion
tldr: Predicts prunable residual computations per forward at test time with a shared-encoder pruner and parallel pipeline for aggressive diffusion-policy sparsity.
relevance_reason: Dynamic pruning of action diffusion.

title: PocketDP3: Efficient Pocket-Scale 3D Visuomotor Policy
reported_metric: <1% of prior methods' parameters
tldr: Replaces DP3's heavy U-Net decoder with a lightweight Mixer-based diffusion decoder, shrinking parameters by >100x and enabling two-step inference.
relevance_reason: Shows decoder over-parameterization in diffusion policies.

title: X-Distill: Cross-Architecture Vision Distillation for Visuomotor Learning
tldr: Distills DINOv2 representations into a compact ResNet-18 on ImageNet, then fine-tunes it with a diffusion policy, outperforming both originals.
relevance_reason: Encoder compression via distillation for policies.
found_via: search: knowledge distillation robot manipulation policy

title: DIDO: Distilling Interaction-Centric Dynamics into One-Step Denoising for World Action Models
tldr: Distills multi-step WAM video generation into one step while explicitly supervising gripper-object interaction dynamics that naive truncation loses.
relevance_reason: Distillation for faster world-action models.

title: WAM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for World Action Models
tldr: Repairs capability lost by an accelerated one-step WAM student through on-policy distillation from a frozen teacher on student-visited histories.
relevance_reason: Recovering compressed world-action models.

title: WAM-Diff2: Hierarchical AR-to-Diffusion Distillation for Highly Efficient Autonomous Driving VLA
tldr: Converts an autoregressive driving VLA into a parallel discrete-diffusion VLA via progressive block-wise and model-wise distillation.
relevance_reason: Distillation-based architectural conversion for speed.

title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
reported_metric: 4-bit: 71.9% BridgeData V2 success (matching bf16), GPU memory 16.8 GB -> 7.0 GB
tldr: Open 7B VLA; its paper reports 4-bit inference matching bf16 real-robot success while more than halving GPU memory, a baseline for later VLA compression work.
relevance_reason: Seed; de facto base model and first VLA quantization evidence.

title: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for LLM Compression and Acceleration
tldr: Protects the small fraction of weight channels that matter most (judged by activation magnitude) via per-channel scaling, enabling accurate 4-bit weight-only LLM quantization.
relevance_reason: Standard PTQ baseline used in VLA quantization comparisons.

title: GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers
tldr: One-shot layer-wise weight quantization using approximate second-order information, scaling 3-4 bit quantization to 175B-parameter models.
relevance_reason: Foundational PTQ method built on by VLA quantizers.

title: SmoothQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models
tldr: Migrates activation outlier difficulty into weights through an equivalent scaling, enabling accurate W8A8 LLM inference.
relevance_reason: Common baseline in VLA PTQ papers (e.g., QVLA).

title: QuaRot: Outlier-Free 4-Bit Inference in Rotated LLMs
tldr: Rotates hidden states with Hadamard transforms to remove outliers so weights, activations and KV cache can all be quantized to 4 bits.
relevance_reason: Rotation basis for W4A4 VLA methods (HoloQ-VLA, FoldQuantVLA).

title: SpinQuant: LLM quantization with learned rotations
tldr: Learns the rotation matrices for outlier removal instead of using random Hadamard, improving 4-bit LLM quantization.
relevance_reason: Rotation-PTQ technique used as VLA baseline.

title: The Era of 1-bit LLMs: All Large Language Models are in 1.58 Bits
tldr: Trains LLMs from scratch with ternary {-1,0,1} weights that match full-precision perplexity at scale with large efficiency gains.
relevance_reason: Direct foundation of BitVLA.

title: BitNet b1.58 2B4T Technical Report
tldr: Releases an open-weight native 1.58-bit 2B LLM trained on 4T tokens with efficient inference kernels.
relevance_reason: Backbone of BitVLA.

title: LLM.int8(): 8-bit Matrix Multiplication for Transformers at Scale
tldr: Mixed-precision decomposition that keeps outlier features in 16-bit and the rest in INT8, enabling 8-bit inference for large transformers (bitsandbytes).
relevance_reason: 8-bit path used by OpenVLA inference.

title: SparseGPT: Massive Language Models Can Be Accurately Pruned in One-Shot
tldr: One-shot pruning of GPT-scale models to 50%+ sparsity without retraining via approximate sparse regression.
relevance_reason: LLM pruning baseline applied to VLAs (e.g., GLUESTICK study).

title: A Simple and Effective Pruning Approach for Large Language Models
tldr: Prunes weights by magnitude times input activation norm, no retraining or weight update needed.
relevance_reason: Pruning baseline used in VLA pruning papers.

title: ShortGPT: Layers in Large Language Models are More Redundant Than You Expect
tldr: Shows many LLM layers are redundant by a block-influence metric and removes them directly.
relevance_reason: Basis for depth pruning of VLA backbones.

title: Consistency Models
tldr: Generative models mapping any noisy point directly to data, trainable by distillation or standalone, for one/few-step sampling.
relevance_reason: Foundation of Consistency Policy / ManiCM.

title: Progressive Distillation for Fast Sampling of Diffusion Models
tldr: Repeatedly distills a diffusion sampler into one with half the steps, reaching few-step sampling.
relevance_reason: Foundation of diffusion-policy step distillation.

title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
tldr: Introduces distillation of an ensemble/large model into a small one via temperature-softened output targets.
relevance_reason: Origin of teacher-student compression.

title: From Inference Efficiency to Embodied Efficiency: Revisiting Efficiency Metrics for Vision-Language-Action Models
techniques: evaluation of compression, token sparsification, action compression
tldr: Shows parameters/FLOPs/throughput poorly predict real efficiency: compressed or sparsified VLAs can take longer, move less smoothly and use more energy despite similar success.
relevance_reason: Directly asks whether compression helps once closed-loop effects are counted.

title: The Speedup Paradox: Rethinking Inference Speed-Quality Trade-off in Embodied Tasks
techniques: analysis of quantization, pruning, async inference
tldr: Analytical framework decomposing how lossy speedups (quantization, pruning, async inference) translate into task-level time, revealing cases where per-step savings are offset by extra steps or failures.
relevance_reason: Quantifies speed-quality tradeoff of compression in embodied loops.

title: Embodied Foundation Models at the Edge: A Survey of Deployment Constraints and Mitigation Strategies
tldr: Survey framing edge deployment of embodied foundation models as eight coupled barriers; notes autoregressive VLAs are memory-bandwidth bound while diffusion controllers are compute-latency bound.
relevance_reason: Survey covering compression within system constraints.

title: A Survey on Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Survey organizing efficient-VLA work across inference, training and data, including quantization, pruning and distillation of VLAs.
relevance_reason: Key survey with compression taxonomy.

title: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models for Embodied Manipulation: A Systematic Survey
tldr: Systematic survey of VLA efficiency methods grouped by architecture, perception features, action generation and training/inference strategies.
relevance_reason: Survey covering compression.

title: Device-Conditioned Neural Architecture Search for Efficient Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Trains one supernet over architectures and mixed-precision bit-widths with device lookup tables so a quantized visuomotor policy can be extracted per robot device without re-optimization.
relevance_reason: Hardware-conditioned quantization for robot policies.

title: AC^2-VLA: Action-Context-Aware Adaptive Computation in Vision-Language-Action Models for Efficient Robotic Manipulation
tldr: Conditions which backbone components execute, which tokens are kept and when features are reused on the current action context.
relevance_reason: Dynamic depth/compute reduction in VLAs.

title: LoopVLA: Learning Sufficiency in Recurrent Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Replaces a deep stack with a repeatedly applied shared transformer block and learns when the representation is sufficient to act.
relevance_reason: Weight sharing + learned early exit for VLAs.

title: CEED-VLA: Consistency Vision-Language-Action Model with Early-Exit Decoding
tldr: Consistency-distills an autoregressive VLA to emit multiple correct action tokens per Jacobi iteration and exits decoding early to accelerate.
relevance_reason: Distillation for faster VLA decoding.

title: Depth-Wise Probing and Pruning of the Planning Token in a Driving Vision-Language-Action Model
tldr: Probes a driving VLA's planning token across depth and finds intent decodable early while trajectory quality needs depth, informing how far layers can be pruned.
relevance_reason: Depth-pruning analysis for driving VLAs.

title: QuaRL: Quantization for Fast and Environmentally Sustainable Reinforcement Learning
reported_metric: 1.5-5.41x end-to-end training speedup
tldr: Shows RL policies tolerate quantization and uses 8-bit actors to speed distributed RL data collection without hurting convergence.
relevance_reason: Early policy quantization evidence cited by QAIL.

title: Low Precision Policy Distillation with Application to Low-Power, Real-time Sensation-Cognition-Action Loop with Neuromorphic Computing
tldr: Distills a full-precision RL policy into a low-precision network running real-time on neuromorphic hardware.
relevance_reason: Early low-precision policy distillation (pre-2022).

title: Bitnet.cpp: Efficient Edge Inference for Ternary LLMs
reported_metric: up to 6.25x speed over full-precision baselines
tldr: Inference library with ternary lookup-table and int2 kernels for fast lossless BitNet b1.58 inference on edge CPUs.
relevance_reason: Runtime enabling 1-bit VLAs on edge.

title: FastAct: A Lightweight Actor Compression Framework for Fast Policy Learning
tldr: Accelerates RL training by dynamically compressing the actor network with a compressor and scheduler for faster experience generation.
relevance_reason: Policy compression in RL; not foundation-model scale.

title: Pruning With Scaled Policy Constraints for Light-Weight Reinforcement Learning
tldr: Structured pruning of deep RL policies with scaled policy constraints to keep performance at high pruning ratios on standard hardware.
relevance_reason: Same group as QAIL; structured pruning of control policies.

title: On-Device Diffusion Transformer Policy for Efficient Robot Manipulation
tldr: LightDP prunes the diffusion-transformer denoiser with a unified prune-and-retrain pipeline and combines it with fewer sampling steps for real-time diffusion policies on mobile hardware.
relevance_reason: Pruning+distillation of diffusion policies for on-device use.

title: Environment-Aware Adaptive Pruning with Interleaved Inference Orchestration for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: EcoVLA adapts channel sparsity to the changing environment using temporal consistency and interleaves pruned/unpruned inference, combinable with other accelerations.
relevance_reason: Training-free parameter sparsification for VLAs.

title: Differentiable Weightless Controllers: Learning Logic Circuits for Continuous Control
tldr: Learns control policies as differentiable logic circuits that compile to FPGA with single-cycle latency, competitive with full-precision or quantized nets.
relevance_reason: Extreme-compression alternative to binary networks for control.

title: Assessing the Potential for Catastrophic Failure in Dynamic Post-Training Quantization
tldr: Learns adversarial network/bit-width pairs to reveal input distributions under which dynamic PTQ fails catastrophically, relevant to safety-critical deployment.
relevance_reason: Generic PTQ failure analysis, not robot-evaluated.
found_via: search: quantization reinforcement learning policy deployment

title: BitRL: Reinforcement Learning with 1-bit Quantized Language Models for Resource-Constrained Edge Deployment
reported_metric: 10-16x memory reduction, 3-5x energy efficiency
tldr: Builds RL agents on ternary BitNet LLMs for on-device learning/inference under tight memory and energy budgets.
relevance_reason: 1-bit LLM agents; limited embodied evaluation.
found_via: search: quantization reinforcement learning policy deployment

title: FlashDrive: Flash Vision-Language-Action Inference for Autonomous Driving
tldr: Algorithm-system co-design attacking four cascaded bottlenecks of driving VLAs (encoding, prefill, reasoning, denoising) simultaneously.
relevance_reason: Mostly non-compression acceleration.

title: EdgeNav-QE: QLoRA Quantization and Dynamic Early Exit for LAM-based Navigation on Edge Devices
venue: ACM TOMM (Trans. Multimedia Computing, Communications & Applications)
tldr: Quantizes a large action model backbone to 4-bit with QLoRA adaptation and adds early-exit branches so simple navigation steps terminate early on edge devices.
relevance_reason: Combined quantization+early exit for embodied navigation on edge.

title: Boost Embodied AI Models with Robust Compression Boundary
tldr: Studies how far standard compression can be pushed on embodied AI models (driving, robotics) before robustness breaks, proposing a robust compression boundary.
relevance_reason: Embodied-specific compression robustness study.

title: Exploring Policy Distillation for Vision-Language-Action Generalist Robotic Policies
tldr: Short overview contrasting distilling VLA generalists into compact RL experts, using RL experts to train generalists, and distilling privileged teachers into VLAs.
relevance_reason: Brief overview of VLA policy distillation.

title: MiniUAV-VLA: A Compact Vision–Language–Action Model for Cooperative Multi-UAV Search and Elimination via MARL Expert Distillation
tldr: Distills a QMIX multi-agent expert into a compact centralized VLA controller for simulated multi-UAV missions.
relevance_reason: Compact distilled VLA, simulation only.

title: Theia: Distilling Diverse Vision Foundation Models for Robot Learning
tldr: Distills several vision foundation models into one compact robot-learning encoder that beats its teachers with smaller size and less data.
relevance_reason: Compact perception backbone via distillation for policies.

title: LocalNav: Distilling Frontier VLMs and Embodied RL for On-Device Object Goal Navigation
tldr: Distills frontier-VLM scene-graph reasoning into a 4B local VLM running on Jetson for object-goal navigation.
relevance_reason: Large-to-small distillation for onboard embodied reasoning.

title: TeTRA-VPR: A Ternary Transformer Approach for Compact Visual Place Recognition
tldr: Progressively quantizes a ViT backbone to ternary/2-bit and binarizes its embedding with distillation for compact visual place recognition on drones and mobile robots.
relevance_reason: Ultra-low-bit transformer for robot perception.

title: Tiny Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Locomotion using Decision Transformers
tldr: Casts imitation learning as sequence modeling with a small decision transformer made deployable on ultra-low-cost robot hardware.
relevance_reason: Tiny policies for constrained robots.

title: Variational Distillation of Diffusion Policies into Mixture of Experts
tldr: Distills a diffusion policy into a mixture-of-experts policy via variational inference, keeping multimodality with fast, tractable inference.
relevance_reason: Distilling diffusion policies into fast students.

title: Fast Action Generation via Knowledge Distillation with Flow Matching for Social Navigation
tldr: Distills a slow conditional diffusion navigation policy into a fast flow-matching-based generator for real-time social navigation.
relevance_reason: Diffusion-policy distillation for real-time mobile robots.

title: eVGGT: An Efficient Geometry-Aware Vision Encoder for Visuomotor Policies
tldr: Distills the heavy VGGT geometry model into a lightweight encoder usable inside ACT/Diffusion Policy with better success than 2D encoders.
relevance_reason: Encoder compression via distillation for policies.

title: S-VAM: Shortcut Video-Action Model by Self-Distilling Geometric and Semantic Foresight
tldr: Self-distills multi-step video foresight into single-pass geometric/semantic predictions so a video-action model runs in real time.
relevance_reason: Distillation to speed video-action models.

title: BitNet: Scaling 1-bit Transformers for Large Language Models
tldr: Introduces BitLinear to train 1-bit-weight transformers from scratch with competitive LM quality and lower energy.
relevance_reason: Root of BitNet line used by BitVLA.

title: OpenPi π₀.₅ on Jetson Thor
reported_metric: ~132 ms (BF16 PyTorch) -> ~54 ms (TRT FP8) -> ~49 ms (TRT FP8+NVFP4), ~2.7x
tldr: Step-by-step NVIDIA tutorial deploying pi0.5 on Jetson Thor with TensorRT FP8 and NVFP4, cutting per-inference latency ~2.7x at action horizon 10.
relevance_reason: Practitioner recipe for low-precision VLA on robot compute.
found_via: web search: quantized pi0 GR00T Jetson

title: MotuBrain: An Advanced World Action Model for Robot Control
reported_metric: >50x speedup over naive baseline; up to 11 Hz inference
tldr: Unified world-action model whose deployment stack combines FP8 quantization with step reduction, compilation and DiT caching to reach real-time chunked control.
relevance_reason: FP8 quantization as part of a WAM deployment recipe.

title: DynaNav: Dynamic Feature and Layer Selection for Efficient Visual Navigation
reported_metric: 2.26x fewer FLOPs, 42.3% lower inference time, 32.8% lower memory vs ViNT
tldr: Adds a hard feature selector and Bayesian-optimized early exits to a navigation foundation model so compute scales with scene complexity.
relevance_reason: Dynamic depth compression of a navigation foundation model.

title: Harnessing Input-Adaptive Inference for Efficient VLN
tldr: Shows naive input-adaptive methods hurt VLN transformers and proposes view selection, importance-based early-exit thresholds and view caching to cut compute.
relevance_reason: Early-exit compression for embodied navigation models.

title: Efficient Inference for Vision-Language-Action Models: A Comprehensive Review of Acceleration Techniques
tldr: Review of VLA inference acceleration organized by input optimization and model-side techniques, framed around sub-100 ms control requirements.
relevance_reason: Minor survey.
